tasks.text: Cloud services enable convenient data storage.
Google Drive and OneDrive are popular cloud storages.
Synchronization helps keep the same files on all devices.
Documents stored in the cloud can be edited from anywhere.
Always use a strong password for your cloud account.
Sharing links makes it easy to send large files.
The cloud provides backup if your computer breaks.
Online office programs do not require installation.
Cloud services require a stable internet connection.
